rationale: Maximized critical-load energy served at 14.4 kWh (the maximum deliverable given EV battery capacities and reserve SOC constraints). EV A delivers 7.2 kWh (ending at 16.0 kWh reserve) and EV B delivers 7.2 kWh (ending at 12.0 kWh reserve). Dispatch respects discharge power limits (8 kW for EV A, 6 kW for EV B). Critical load demand is 15.5 kWh but only 14.4 kWh can be delivered due to battery energy constraints.
